items.headline: adidas Tobacco goes triple black
items.caption: A Japan-only, all-black suede Tobacco.
body: Full suede uppers and a creamy leather lining.
The Tobacco works best in quiet colours, and this is the quietest yet.
How to wear it: black jeans, black knit, done.

items.headline: A 'Green Screen' Air Jordan 11 for Space Jam's 30th
items.caption: Tonal green suede that feels very Bottega.
body: It's inspired by the green screens used to make Space Jam.
Highsnobiety says the colour recalls Bottega Veneta's signature green.
How to wear it: cream trousers and a white tee.

items.headline: New Balance × USM made cold-plunge tanks
items.caption: Modular wooden ice baths for New York marathon runners.
body: The furniture maker's chrome frames hold wooden plunge tubs.
It's a gift to runners cooling off after training.
Style lesson: good design isn't only clothes.

items.headline: Nike SB's champagne-bottle Dunk
items.caption: Glossy green patent leather, gold logos and cork insoles.
body: The 'Black Spruce' Dunk Low is inspired by champagne bottles.
It still has Zoom Air for skating.
How to wear it: black trousers for a New Year's Eve party.

items.headline: Paint-splattered jeans are in. Do painters approve?
items.caption: Ralph Lauren put them on the runway; GQ asked real artists.
body: A model walked out in paint-flecked denim at Ralph Lauren's autumn/winter '26 show.
GQ spoke to artists about what the trend says about the wearer.
How to wear it: everything else clean and simple.

items.headline: Tailors pick the best-dressed James Bond
items.caption: From Connery to Craig, who wore the suit best?
body: British tailors weigh in on 25 films and seven Bonds.
Customers still walk in asking to look like 007.
How to wear it: navy two-piece, white shirt, sharp shoulders.

items.headline: Tom Hardy's navy rib jumper in 'MobLand'
items.caption: The one reliable knit every guy needs this season.
body: Hardy's fixer Harry Da Souza wears a chunky navy rib knit in episode seven.
Esquire calls it the easiest win of the season.
How to wear it: over a white tee with dark jeans.

items.headline: Haider Ackermann: the model of modern elegance
items.caption: Tom Ford's creative director, honoured in Esquire's Better Men list.
body: The Colombian designer earlier turned Berluti into a hot ticket.
He has led Tom Ford for two years.
Style lesson: fewer pieces, better cut.

items.headline: Kit Butler, the most successful male model of his generation
items.caption: Campaigns for Dolce & Gabbana, Burberry and Versace by 28.
body: Steven Meisel shoots him regularly.
Butler says it still surprises him that this is his life.
Style lesson: confidence does most of the work.

items.headline: Frederique Constant's burgundy perpetual calendar
items.caption: A limited run of 100, with a burgundy dial and a spare alligator strap.
body: The redesigned perpetual calendar gets a rich burgundy dial.
Only 100 pieces will be made.
How to wear it: with a grey suit or a camel coat.

items.headline: Students fill a football field with food donations
items.caption: Over a quarter of a million pounds of food for New Jersey food banks.
body: Hundreds of students joined the second 100-Yard Food Drive Challenge.
Donation bags covered Howell High School's field end zone to end zone.
It was the biggest drive in the nonprofit Dermer Dreams' history.

items.headline: A support dog wakes a deaf owner to save her husband
items.caption: Storm sensed something was wrong after a midnight fall.
body: Sandra Donally was asleep when her dog Storm leapt onto the bed.
Her husband Gary had fallen down the stairs and was unconscious.
The alert got him help in time.

items.headline: Rangers use phones and tracking skills to protect desert lions
items.caption: In Namibia, tech and tradition help farmers and a recovering lion population live side by side.
body: Community rangers combine real-time data with traditional tracking.
They warn farmers when lions are near to protect livestock.
That helps keep the lions safe too.
